display_name: 源域相位对齐重复结构诊断
description: 固定六个时延，测量源域复相关与源 clean 最优非负修正量；只用于波形诊断。

data.representation: 672 received/clean source IQ paired records with public RX and view

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source waveform-only diagnostic; no identity accuracy or target selection

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source-only provenance; fixed legal L_s/U_s source pilot with TX hidden
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed original DURA source-only provenance previously verified
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed DURA checkpoint and lags 8,16,20,32,40,64 before this diagnostic

expected_artifacts: result.json: source lag correlations and nondeployable source-clean oracle

metric_names: source DURA IQ NMSE and capped positive-step source-clean oracle

rows.method: Non-circular DURA-phase-aligned lag projection; source clean optimal real coefficient clipped to [0,0.5]
rows.purpose: Measure repetition evidence and source-only ideal correction; no deployed model or identity claim
rows.seed_notes: Existing fixed DURA checkpoint and source pilot; no training or target access
rows.scenario: source pilot RX4/6 and RX8 x seven views
expected_artifacts: result.json: source lag correlations and nondeployable source-clean oracle

notes: No F weights or outputs, TX labels, V, target IQ or truth.
Source pilot previously explored; DURA may have seen it, so no independent generalization claim.
Source-clean optimum is unavailable at deployment and neither identity accuracy nor a general upper bound.
Fixed lag20 residual projection diagnostic using historical F50 was different; these data and phase-aligned projection do not claim comparability.
